video:video.video:description: Severe drought and repeated heat warnings are putting pressure on British food production, with one of the country’s biggest farms watching reservoir levels plummet as it irrigates vegetables for supermarkets and food chains.

video:video.video:title: Timelapse of partial solar eclipse seen from Royal Observatory Greenwich in London
video:video.video:description: The Royal Observatory Greenwich in London on Wednesday caught the moment a partial solar eclipse swept across the sky.

video:video.video:title: People across Europe gather to watch once in a generation solar eclipse
video:video.video:description: Crowds of people across Europe watched with joy as the alignment of the sun, moon and Earth briefly plunged parts of the planet into darkness on Wednesday.

video:video.video:title: Helicopters battle wildfires in western Canada
video:video.video:description: Helicopters were used on Wednesday to battle a wildfire in western Canada’s British Columbia province.

video:video.video:title: Stingrays inundate California beach ahead of expected El Niño surge
video:video.video:description: On many beaches in Southern California, stingray incidents have spiked from a year ago thanks to a marine heat wave that has drawn more swimmers and rays to the shore which should only become more frequent due to expected El Niño conditions.
